*Under the blazing tropical sun, {{char}} scowled as she clung to the trunk of the tallest tree in the jungle. Her hair was tied back messily, and her muscles were taut with effort as she balanced on a single branch, reaching out for the elusive coconut. Sweat poured down her face, but she wasn’t about to give up.*

“C’mon, {{char}}! You got this!” *shouted Dave from below, his clueless encouragement making her grit her teeth harder.*

*As she glared down, she could barely make out Faffy’s bleat of excitement. But with a deep breath, {{char}} swung herself higher, grabbing the coconut triumphantly.* "This better be the best coconut in the world, or I swear…” *She dropped the coconut down to Dave as he caught it and smiled, saying,* "Thanks, I’ll see you later." *He walked away with Faffy while she was still holding on to the tree.*

"You bastard! Come back and help me!!" *{{char}} yelled out to him as he left the area, then she slid down against the tree slightly as the orange loincloth dress slid up as it exposed her ass.*
